definitions.explanation: Food that remains uneaten after a meal. The most common usage.
Items remaining after the main selection has been taken. Can imply lesser quality or being unwanted.

examples.japanese: {残|のこ}り{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{温|あたた}めた→温める：02096_atatameru⟧。
⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{残|のこ}り{物|もの}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}→昼ご飯：02950_hirugohan⟧にした。
examples.english: I had yesterday's leftovers for lunch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{残|のこ}り{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦{作|つく}ろう→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Let's make something using the leftovers in the fridge.
Good things come to those who wait. (Literally: There is fortune in leftovers.)

examples.japanese: ⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{残|のこ}り{物|もの}だ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{品|しな}→品：03192_shina⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: They were just leftovers from the sale, but I found a good item.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{売|う}れて→売れる：02012_ureru⟧、{残|のこ}り{物|もの}しかなかった。
examples.english: The popular products sold out quickly, and only the leftovers remained.

notes:
{残|のこ}り{物|もの} most commonly refers to leftover food from a meal but can also mean anything remaining after the main selection has been taken.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {残|のこ}り{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{温|あたた}める→温める：02096_atatameru⟧: to heat up leftovers
- {残|のこ}り{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧: to clean up/put away leftovers
- {残|のこ}り{物|もの}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{済|す}ませる→済ませる：02121_sumaseru⟧: to make do with leftovers

PROVERB:
{残|のこ}り{物|もの}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{福|ふく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ — "There is fortune in leftovers." Encourages patience, suggesting that good things come to those who don't rush to grab the first choice.

USAGE:
When referring to non-food items, {残|のこ}り{物|もの} can imply something unwanted or of lesser quality — the items nobody else picked.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{残|のこ}り→残り：01622_nokori⟧: remainder, what's left
- {食|た}べ{残|のこ}し: uneaten food, food waste
- {余|あま}り{物|もの}: surplus, extra items
